profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer with a track record of driving impactful projects in diverse environments. Started my journey as the sole developer at a dynamic marketing firm, where I honed my skills in problem-solving and innovative thinking. Transitioned to a pivotal role at a healthcare company, where I spearheaded the integration of cutting-edge technology, transitioning from legacy Ruby code to modern Flutter frameworks.

My passion lies in leveraging technology to solve complex challenges and drive tangible results. Let's connect and explore how we can innovate together.

positions.title: Web Software Engineer
positions.description:
Typescript | Javascript | Jest | Playwright | Azure | Material UI 

- Developed application-wide improvements, including time stamps for devices across all U.S. time zones, ensuring they display correctly in each user's local zone—or any other—while accounting for daylight saving time and standard time

- Implemented test-driven development in Jest during two-week sprints to ensure functions and components remain well-structured, modular, and highly testable.

- Wrote comprehensive documentation for each pull request, Confluence page, and sprint ticket, fostering a collaborative environment through both written and verbal communication.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Jest · React · JavaScript · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Javacript | Python | Node.js | React | CSS

- Developed and maintained the homepage during some of the busiest weeks of the year which include Father's Day, Back-to-School, and 4th of July.

- Curated products to be in showcased or visible during pivotal moments that match the expectations of an E-Commerce company. Which include but are not limited to new releases, sporting events, trending items, and items on sale.

- Partnered with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Design, Project Management, and Development), even on early-morning and late-nights, to have discussions that drive alignment and deliver on mutual objectives.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Javascript | React | Ruby | Flutter | Node.js | CSS

- Worked with a small group of developers that was part of an initiative to remove legacy Ruby code to modernize the application in the newer framework of React.

-Created and implemented proof-of-concepts for the mobile application in Flutter that met both requirements of being functional and visually true to the design of the Figma documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: React · JavaScript · Ruby · Front-end Coding · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
JavaScript | Python | Flutter | Next.js | | Node.js | Amazon Web Services (AWS) | Shopify | WordPress

- Led a small team of developers to establish creative solutions for client's needs based on their industry, target demographic, and other metrics used to increase sales and visibility

- Built Shopify Themes from the ground up from mock-ups created in Figma. 

- Maintained online stores for existing clients and communicated additional ideas to increase their digital presence.

- Created responsive websites that would be compatible with iOS, Android, and the web using a variety of platforms in a fast paced environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Figma (Software) · JavaScript · HTML5 · Shopify · Web Development · Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · WordPress · Git · Bootstrap (Framework)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Hopeworks is a non-profit organization whose main goal is to expose minorities to computer science in general, and more specifically, web development. They allow the members who sign up to work with real world clients to gain confidence in a field they may have never thought to be exposed to while also gaining practical experience.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS · JavaScript · HTML5 · WordPress · Elementor
